|strategy=By Paul Evans<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/dark/small/mindtricksdontworkonme.html</ref>

The one-turn beatdown has become a devastating maneuver used to decimate the Dark Side for years. Not any more with this card. With this card on the table, it sets up a safety blanket for the Dark Side, allowing them to leave a location a little thinner than they would like to, just the same as with a [[Ghhhk]]. Best of all, it is an Effect and cannot be denied use by the [[Frozen Assets]]/[[Draw Their Fire]] or [[Beggar]]/[[Draw Their Fire]] combos widely used in today's metagame.

Even better, this card can be used offensively by dropping an Enhanced character to take care of [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]] or taking on the entire scout beatdown crew on [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]] to remove Midge from play. Either way it is used, the tricks the Light Side has won't work on this card.
|rulings=* Cards that cannot be forfeited (such as a character not participating in battle, or a [[Floating Refinery]]) do not prevent a player from canceling all remaining battle damage.<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json card data], entry <code>12_136</code>, <code>rulings</code> field. A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the type bar) with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Cor-D-mindtricksdontworkonme-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Mind Tricks Don't Work On Me (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): Same words as the previous version. The slip no longer prints the title in its black strip; the “E” stays at the lower right.

The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip, both as cut from their sheets at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
